# External evidence register

No external evidence is attached or implied by this register. Each item below
is intentionally blocked until the named accountable party supplies the
specified evidence through the signed-manifest process in
[`../README.md`](../README.md).

| Ledger IDs | Dependency | Accountable external role | Evidence needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| PRIV-001–003 | Personal field, table, and governance-profile decisions | Appointed privacy/data owners and counsel | Signed scope-specific approval manifests, responsible identity/organization, approval reference, reviewed artifact, and digest |
| EXT-001 | Bounded pilot authority and geography | Participating authority sponsor | Written authorization naming authority, geography, services, users, and scope |
| EXT-002 | Hosting, identity, storage/KMS, and operations | Authorized hosting/operator organization | Approved architecture, account/region, key policy, identity contract, named operators, and service evidence |
| EXT-003 | Official service connectors | Government service owner | Written integration authorization, current contract/specification, credentials issued through approved process, and sandbox approval |
| EXT-004 | Independent security and quality assessment | Authorized independent assessor / STQC as applicable | Signed scoped assessment reports and final determination; assessment is not inferred from self-test |
| EXT-005 | Live SIEM and incident ownership | Authorized security operations owner | Deployed event sink, monitoring/acknowledgement proof, on-call/escalation ownership, and approved runbooks |

An authority waiver is not an engineering substitute. It requires a signed,
scoped waiver and recorded reason; the authorized gate accepts only
independently verified external evidence or a valid authority waiver.
